description: Runs a JavaScript regex over sample text and returns matches and groups (capped sizes). Returns { count, matches }: up to 100 matches, each { match, index, groups }. Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

flags.description: Regex flags from g, i, m, s, u, y; g is always added.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source, without slashes, up to 200 characters.

text.description: Sample text to search, up to 2,000 characters.
